structural_feature: Proof of Zero Allostery from Static Cryo-EM Core Rigidity
prior_art_source: Contradicted by biophysical literature (Cooper & Dryden 1983; Nandakumar 2012; Sekne 2022; Nat Commun Chem 2023)
original_publication_finding: Biochemical literature proves TPP1 stimulates repeat addition processivity (RAP) and modulates DNA exit path. Cryo-EM vitrification lacks dNTPs and active elongation. Dynamic allostery occurs without large backbone changes.
this_repo_claim: Claims catalytic active site is completely decoupled and rules out allosteric communication based solely on static 0.338 A RMSD.
notes: Methodological fallacy: coordinate invariance in a static cryo-EM model does not rule out dynamic or thermodynamic allosteric coupling.
